title: Singular negative olla
focus: Form en ole, et ole, and ei ole with singular subjects.

exercises.prompt: Complete “I am not at work tomorrow.” Minä ____ työssä huomenna.
exercises.explanation: Minä uses en ole: the negative verb marks the person and olla becomes ole.

optionFeedback.en ole: Correct. Minä uses en ole: the negative verb marks the person and olla becomes ole.
optionFeedback.et ole: “et ole” does not fit this subject or construction. Minä uses en ole: the negative verb marks the person and olla becomes ole.
optionFeedback.ei ole: “ei ole” does not fit this subject or construction. Minä uses en ole: the negative verb marks the person and olla becomes ole.

sentenceExplanation.translation: I am not at work tomorrow.
sentenceExplanation.pattern: subject + person-marked negative verb + ole + context

parts.role: subject: the person or people described by the sentence
parts.formation: subject pronoun; no ending is added

parts.role: negative verb: carries the person agreement
parts.formation: minä takes the negative-verb form en

parts.role: main verb after the negative verb
parts.formation: olla uses the fixed form ole after the negative verb

parts.role: context: tells the location or state
parts.formation: supplied as a complete fixed expression; no change is required

exercises.misconceptionCategory: Singular negative olla: form not yet secure
